known_constraints: Do not modify main directly or merge pull requests automatically.
Do not claim tests or simulations passed unless a run result proves it.
Synthetic fixtures are not physical measurements or field-performance evidence.
Do not treat the 175.8 uH current-sheet estimate as a measured final inductance.
Evaluate an independent Greenhouse-style segment inductance method before choosing final coil inductance.
Include the 12 radial transition connectors and correct current directions in any segment-based coil inductance model.
Do not expose secrets in source files, reports, or logs.
Free-only: no paid API, subscription, hosted service, or paid runner.
The local task queue edits the JSON memory file only; it does not push commits or call remote services.

This is a diagnostic of matrix inconsistency in the reduced-order representation, not a physical target-detectability limit. A resolution sweep (48–384 polygon segments) is in progress to distinguish polygon quadrature error from a deeper annulus-basis inconsistency. Raising ring polygon resolution 48→384 did not change either failing pivot at displayed precision: -3.313138e-9 H for 6 mm radius/1 mm thickness and -6.626277e-9 H for 12 mm radius/2 mm thickness. Condition numbers at 3→5 rings were 140213.9→438468.8 (small radius) and 70115.5→219278.5 (thick disk), already poor. Likely issue is radial annulus basis and/or inconsistent rectangular-annulus self/mutual terms, not polygon segmentation alone. No lower-ring workaround is accepted; no diagonal loading or relaxed Cholesky gate. current_evidence.greenhouse_review: Added a theoretical audit of the straight round-wire partial self-inductance formula, its uniform-DC internal-field assumption, the exact Grover/Rosa expression and long-wire approximation, and the need to distinguish partial inductance from a complete two-terminal measurement including return leads. Strengthened segmentation-invariance acceptance test: preserve length alone is insufficient; splitting requires the corresponding mutual term in a finite-cross-section-consistent reference. Documentation only; no numerical engine or tests executed. Further review against the NBS Rosa–Grover primary source (1912) identified a distinct collinear-adjacent-segment case, equation (102): h=0 must not be passed to the offset-parallel filament formula. The study now specifies merge of contiguous same-direction collinear conductor pieces as one physical straight segment, or use the dedicated collinear mutual term if retained separately; overlapping collinear geometry requires explicit review. Acceptance test G-04 now requires the collinear mutual term when testing subdivision invariance. Documentation only; no calculation engine/tests executed. Clarified an important GMD distinction from NBS Rosa–Grover equation (136): for two non-overlapping circular cross-sectional areas, their mutual GMD equals the center spacing exactly. This does not make center-spacing substitution exact in the finite-length Neumann kernel; it is exact only in the logarithmic/GMD reduction, while the finite-segment reference remains the cross-sectional average. Documentation only; no numerical engine/tests executed. Added energy-based derivation of L_eq = sum(L_ii) + 2 sum_{i<j}(M_ij) for one series path carrying identical current, with explicit no-double-count rules for self/internal and mutual terms, one-time direction sign, and full-matrix versus unordered-pair summation. Added physical-corner limitation: sharp 90-degree polyline has zero ideal-filament mutual term for perpendicular straight pieces, but a real rounded bend requires measured bend radius and arc refinement; added acceptance tests G-13/G-14. Documentation only; no numerical engine/tests executed. Added Section 5 on copper skin depth and proximity effect for the 0.60 mm wire: reference δ values at 1 kHz, 10 kHz, 50 kHz, 100 kHz and 1 MHz; radius crossover near 48.5 kHz as a gradual scale, not a sharp threshold; pulse spectrum must be derived from measured current waveform and edge times rather than repetition frequency alone; adjacent-turn proximity requires actual segment direction; separated quasi-static L, frequency-dependent Z(f), and transient PI response. Documentation only; no pulse spectrum, proximity factor, impedance, simulation, or physical measurement established; no coil defaults changed. Added a small Python reference module simulation/spiral/conductor_effects.py with validated helpers for classical copper skin depth, the frequency where delta equals wire radius, and the approximate first-order 10-90% edge-knee scale; added five unit tests and registered the module/tests in tools/islam_agent/audit.py. The five new tests passed in an isolated local Python test run of the helper logic. This is not a full repository audit or GitHub Actions pass; latest GitHub Actions remains startup_failure before jobs. The helper intentionally does not calculate proximity effect, pulse spectrum, or PI transient response. Implemented an initial production reference estimator in simulation/spiral/greenhouse_inductance.py with 19 unit tests. It merges the 12 collinear connectors into 52 straights, uses finite round-wire self terms and finite-length parallel mutual integrals averaged over both circular cross-sections, tracks current-direction signs, and includes the factor 2 once. On GitHub audit commit 49ebe864, all 19 new tests passed; 4x16 quadrature reproduces the diagnostic 172.067221 uH partial quasi-static estimate. A dedicated 2x8/4x16/8x32 convergence runner is now in the engineering workflow; its high-order result is pending. No Coil default changed and no physical measurement exists. High-order CI convergence completed successfully in run 44507108734: 2x8 = 172.067225747 uH, 4x16 = 172.067220922 uH, 8x32 = 172.067220922 uH; relative change from 4x16 to 8x32 = 1.1940467835e-13, well below the 0.1% gate. This verifies numerical integration convergence for the assumed geometry and uniform-DC-current cross-section model only; it does not validate the physical coil or PI-frequency effective inductance.

current_evidence.local_agent_design: LocalOllamaClient uses stdlib only, restricts endpoint to 127.0.0.1, disables environment proxies and redirects, bounds timeout/response, uses non-streaming JSON, and validates object responses (9 tests). agent_policy.py enforces exact proposal schema, task ID, fixed inspect/test allowlists, bounded steps/claims, and mandatory human approval (12 tests). local_agent.py sends bounded task/context to local client, validates returned proposal, returns awaiting_human_approval=true and executed=false, and rejects incomplete responses/oversized context (6 fake-client tests); local_workflow.py connects proposal generation to checkpointed execution only through a separate caller-supplied human_approved=True gate (4 fake-agent integration tests); no real Ollama model was invoked. tool_runner.py supports only bounded read-only file inspection and one fixed agent unittest command with shell=False, timeout, bounded output, and separate human_approved=True (6 tests). checkpoint.py provides strict schema validation, 256 KB file cap, restricted result fields, atomic JSON replacement with fsync, task/run/plan identity, safe state transitions, and O_EXCL exclusive run locks (11 tests). checkpointed_runner.py executes one allowlisted step at a time, saves each successful step, pauses on test failure, resumes by skipping completed steps, retries failed steps, and rejects changed task/run/plan identity (6 tests). local_workflow.py now connects proposal-only generation to checkpointed execution through a separate explicit approval method; proposal generation itself never executes, and the bridge revalidates the pending proposal before forwarding it to the runner (4 fake-agent integration tests). audit.py requires and runs task queue, Ollama client, policy, tool runner, checkpoint, checkpointed runner, local proposal, and local workflow suites. Total agent test cases registered: 62 (8 queue, 9 client, 12 policy, 6 tool runner, 11 checkpoint, 6 checkpointed runner, 6 local proposal, 4 local workflow integration). All 62 agent tests are written, registered, and passed in GitHub Actions; latest audit on commit 96d56bfd passed 46 engineering tests plus 62 agent tests (108 total). current_evidence.rectangular_segment_self_inductance: The rectangular straight-segment Neumann self term and collinear adjacent mutual term remain implemented and independently tested. Added generalized rectangular_parallel_segment_mutual_inductance for two equally oriented parallel segments with the same uniformly filled rectangular cross-section, allowing transverse (dx,dy) and axial offset. Segment A occupies [0,a], segment B [c,c+b]. Axial integration is analytic using F(t,rho)=t asinh(t/rho)-sqrt(t^2+rho^2); the cross-section difference density is triangular and is integrated on split positive/negative Gauss-Legendre panels to resolve its cusp. Added three tests: reduction to adjacent-collinear case, reciprocity under swapping segments and reversing offsets, and far-field limit. The first CI run exposed a 0.018% reduction mismatch from applying quadrature across the triangular-density cusp; split-panel quadrature corrected it, and all 68 geometry tests passed on code commit 5b587e93c5e7f47588f99c805e073ee1a34ee7b3. Mono Spiral transient workflow also passed. Convergence workflow 44513960162 subsequently completed successfully: unit tests, disk convergence, timestep sensitivity, synthetic target sweep, positive-definiteness diagnostics, radial annulus basis diagnostics, provisional coil-inductance sensitivity, Greenhouse convergence and CSV summary all passed. On the latest memory-updated head 72c36bd0e87303b83f8590b7e9de01db86d0b10d, audit run 44514197646 passed: 30 required files, valid memory schema, 63 engineering tests +62 agent tests =125; all 11 rectangular-segment tests passed. Geometry run 44514197758 and transient run 44514197566 passed. A fresh convergence run 44514197623 was still in progress at last inspection: unit tests and disk convergence passed, timestep sensitivity was running, later sweeps pending. The generalized mutual addition is validated by the completed audit/geometry/transient workflows; full fresh convergence is pending. Generalized function remains limited to equally oriented parallel segments with identical cross-sections and uniform current density; it does not handle rotated cross-sections, nonparallel/bent segments, arbitrary loops, skin/proximity or PI pulse spectra. Not integrated into mono_spiral_disk.py or Greenhouse estimator; Coil defaults unchanged.
current_evidence.rectangular_segment_general_mutual: Added simulation/spiral/rectangular_segment_general_mutual.py: a six-dimensional tensor-product Gauss-Legendre Neumann mutual-inductance reference for two straight rectangular conductor prisms with arbitrary axis orientations, explicit orthonormal cross-section frames, and uniform current density. Added five tests for nonparallel far-field behavior, reciprocity, current-direction sign reversal, perpendicular-current zero coupling, and invalid frame rejection. This is a diagnostic quadrature primitive for disjoint straight conductor volumes; near-touching convergence needs a separate order study, and overlapping/intersecting volumes, bends, skin/proximity, nonuniform PI current and complete loop energy are unsupported. Registered the tests in the agent audit. No integration into mono_spiral_disk.py or Greenhouse; no Coil defaults changed. GitHub Actions on this new head is pending.

self_learning_device_charter.title: Single integrated detector with reviewable continuous self-learning
principles: Design one integrated physical detector from a strong scientific, physical, mathematical and algorithmic foundation; do not make rebuilding a new device the normal improvement path.
Provide a transparent, reviewable learning and experiment log, including evidence, conditions, reasoning, changes, failures and outcomes.
Allow the user to inspect learning records, correct data or assumptions, edit algorithms or add code, and validate changes.
Keep the stable detector algorithm running while candidate versions are trained and tested separately; switch only at a safe point after independent validation.
Promote only improvements that pass held-out confirmed data and regression checks; preserve version history and rollback.
Allow automatic learning and bounded calibration/configuration only; physical hardware changes and safety-critical power/protection changes require human engineering intervention.
required_capabilities: algorithm versioning, rationale and reproducible comparisons
independent validation against the current stable version
human correction and algorithm contribution workflow
self_learning_device_charter.operational_cycle: collect -> validate -> learn -> propose -> independently test -> human review/correction -> safe promotion -> monitor/rollback
constraints: Synthetic or unconfirmed data must never be represented as confirmed field measurements.
Self-learning must not autonomously alter hardware, pulse-power limits, or protection settings.
No unvalidated candidate may replace the stable detection algorithm.
This decision is an architectural target, not a claim that the current device is built or field-validated.

agent_scope: Manager cycle selects only tasks with scope=manager. Engineering tasks with scope=engineering are excluded and require the separate engineering/lab runner.
